buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 50% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 50 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 50 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 3. Service & Support AVAILABILITY OF OFFICE OF SERVICE PROVIDER: An office of the Service Provider must be located in the state of Consignee. DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE TO BE SUBMITTED. 4. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 5. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1) Firm Registration Certificate. (2) MSME/ROC. (3) EMD/ EMD Exemption Certificate. (4) NDA. (5) Pan Card. (6) GST Registration should be in the state of consignee i.e Tamil Nadu (7) Annual Turn Over. (8) Income Tax Return last 3 years. (9) Past experience certificate in similar services in Indian Navy . Work Order is to provide along with bid d ocuments.Completion certificate form buyer also to be enclosed duly reference the work order. (10) Bank Mandate. (11) Cancelled Cheque. (12) Signed copy of RFP. (13) Pre Bid Meeting is mandatory as the site visit is required. (14) Buyer must provide the undertaking for agree terms and conditions as mentioned in SOW. (15) The Bidder is to submit detailed plant drawings at the time of bid submission to be evaluated by the b uyer , the bid is likely to be rejected it the same are not enclosed or not found to be satisfactory and in con sonance with requirement. (16) Submission of any fraudulent of misleading documents if detected will lead to summary rejection and subsequent penal action iaw extant rules and regulations.

(17) Bidder is likely to be rejected if incomplete or incorrect documents are submitted by the bidder. Any r ecourse to seeking clarification or giving any further opportunity, will be at sole discretion of the buyer. (18) Bidder is to quote schedule wise. . 6.
